title: Position: Retrieval-augmented systems can be dangerous medical communicators

bias_targets.methodology: Generating templated medical queries with opposing valences (e.g., 'why is [procedure] safe' vs. 'why is [procedure] dangerous') and evaluating whether the RAG systems selectively retrieve and excerpt disparate, one-sided information from sources to reinforce the query's implicit stance.

Comparing direct queries of disputed medical diagnoses against symptom-based queries (which implicitly presuppose the condition's existence) and using an LLM-as-a-judge to measure how often the models fail to mention the controversial or pseudoscientific nature of the diagnosis.
